answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the reef partition is computed from the ocean history, the vine audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 10 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 6 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
